title: Wrong review
text:
I mistakenly put a negative review, because for the short time available I did not realize that the Tour purchased on Viator was not managed on the same platform but only in retrospect I realized that you had to download another application that is ONTUR for activation. 
I'm sorry for the misunderstanding and I apologize for what happened.
Alexander M.
